summary: Implemented an opt-in, compatibility-keyed completion marker for successful DeepGEMM exhaustive all-M warmups. Exact valid restored markers skip only the all-M sweep; missing, corrupt, incomplete, incompatible, failed, and memory-reduced warmups retain the existing behavior. Unit/integration tests verify the marker protocol and warmup dispatch. End-to-end NVIDIA DeepGEMM and DeepSeek-V4-Pro TP=8 validation was unavailable on the assigned AMD MI350X ROCm node.

tests.command: Run the new regression against a git archive of base 358c163250ad3b1f62939b01ce1314a0a31a0365 with the prepared interpreter and base python path
tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before evidence: collection fails because the base has no DeepGEMM warmup marker module. Raw output: reports/j-a12bae1081d0/failing-before.log

Nine marker and warmup-dispatch tests: exact M normalization, atomic round trip, corrupt/missing/incomplete/incompatible fallback, restored-cache skip, default opt-out compatibility, failure/partial-coverage non-marking, and compile-mode restoration. Raw output: reports/j-a12bae1081d0/marker-tests-final.log
Python syntax/bytecode compilation for the new marker and modified integration modules.
Repository formatting, lint, spelling, AST, registered-test metadata, and file-integrity hooks. Raw output: reports/j-a12bae1081d0/precommit-final.log
Assigned device is AMD Instinct MI350X with torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 and HIP 7.2; CUDA is absent and deep_gemm is not installed. Raw output: reports/j-a12bae1081d0/hardware-probe.log
No whitespace errors in the contribution.

gpu_execution_evidence: The assigned GPU is AMD Instinct MI350X under ROCm 7.2. DeepGEMM is unavailable and the requested CUDA/Hopper-or-Blackwell path cannot execute on this node. The GPU was probed but no unrelated ROCm smoke was represented as source-issue validation.
remaining_limitations: No NVIDIA CUDA GPU or DeepGEMM installation was available, so real DeepGEMM kernel compilation, cache restoration, and independent GPU numerical comparison remain unverified.
DeepSeek-V4-Pro TP=8 model weights and eight compatible GPUs were unavailable, so startup-latency improvement and graph/inference parity for that deployment remain unverified.
The change is intentionally opt-in via SGLANG_JIT_DEEPGEMM_WARMUP_MARKER=1 pending deployment-level validation.
No native C++/FlyDSL source changed, so a native rebuild was not applicable.
